name: deadline_reached_during_call
defect: a deadline in the future is not checked during the call, or is checked inverted (design 4.7: a runtime that notices the deadline has passed returns ERR_DEADLINE; this is cooperative). The host's clock is virtual for this call: 1 ms per read of host->now_ns, deadline 2.5 ms ahead, so a runtime that reads the host's clock at least once per row and checks the deadline against it reaches it within the 8 rows, whatever the wall clock does
